subtitles.zh: 彭博独家报道称，特朗普及其盟友正加倍努力，按自己的意愿重塑美联储。我们了解到了什么？

subtitles.en: about that? So the message here is that the political pressure on the fed hasn't gone away,
subtitles.zh: 这表明美联储面临的政治压力并未消退，David。

subtitles.en: David. We've had a couple of things going on this week. We had a Supreme Court ruling in favor of Governor Lisa Cook, who's fighting to hold onto her job. She can stay on her other job as

subtitles.en: Fed Governor for now, while she fights allegations of mortgage fraud that the White House put against her.
subtitles.zh: 她否认这些指控。但该裁决对库克理事而言只是险胜，特朗普及其官员公开表示将继续推进此案，旨在将她逐出理事会。

subtitles.en: She denies those charges. But that ruling was a pretty narrow victory for Governor Cook and by finishing further fed and President Trump and his officials have been at a very publicly
subtitles.zh: 其次，今晚有同事报道，白宫仍关注前主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔理事。尽管他的主席任期已结束，但他仍留在理事会直至2028年。

subtitles.en: and publicly making the point that they will renew and pursue their case against Governor Cook in this legal case with the aim of removing her from the board. And secondly, our colleagues

subtitles.en: reporting tonight, that the White House focus also remains on Governor Jerome Powell, former chair of course, who is remaining on the board, even though his term was chair as finished. He's alive
subtitles.zh: 今晚报道称，白宫关注点仍在杰罗姆·鲍威尔身上，这位前主席虽已卸任主席职务，但仍留在董事会。

subtitles.en: staying aboard in 2028. But his staying on, which has been seen as a sign of a way to protect the fed's independence and as a way to protect himself, he's been subject to a lot of scrutiny and
subtitles.zh: 他留任至2028年，这被视为保护美联储独立性和自身的一种方式，但也因此受到诸多审视。

subtitles.en: attacks by the White House. But his staying on is also making him a target for the White House,
